query: What feasible quasi-experimental strategies (natural experiments, DiD, RDD, IV) can link leader messaging to spikes or shifts in consumption across our sites?

response.query: What feasible quasi-experimental strategies (natural experiments, DiD, RDD, IV) can link leader messaging to spikes or shifts in consumption across our sites?
response.answer: Natural experiments, Difference-in-Differences (DiD), and Instrumental Variables (IV) can link leader messaging to consumption shifts. Regression Discontinuity Design (RDD) can also be used if cutoffs exist.
